briefdescription.para: FSEL - Traditional three-operand fsel node.
XSMAXC[DQ]P, XSMINC[DQ]P - C-type min/max instructions.
FCFID - The FCFID instruction, taking an f64 operand and producing and f64 value containing the FP representation of the integer that was temporarily in the f64 operand.
Newer FCFID[US] integer-to-floating-point conversion instructions for unsigned integers and single-precision outputs.
FCTI[D,W]Z - The FCTIDZ and FCTIWZ instructions, taking an f32 or f64 operand, producing an f64 value containing the integer representation of that FP value.
Newer FCTI[D,W]UZ floating-point-to-integer conversion instructions for unsigned integers with round toward zero.
VEXTS, ByteWidth - takes an input in VSFRC and produces an output in VSFRC that is sign-extended from ByteWidth to a 64-byte integer.
Reciprocal estimate instructions (unary FP ops).
Test instruction for software square root.
Square root instruction.
VPERM - The PPC VPERM Instruction.
XXSPLT - The PPC VSX splat instructions.
XXSPLTI_SP_TO_DP - The PPC VSX splat instructions for immediates for converting immediate single precision numbers to double precision vector or scalar.
XXSPLTI32DX - The PPC XXSPLTI32DX instruction.
VECINSERT - The PPC vector insert instruction.
VECSHL - The PPC vector shift left instruction.
XXPERMDI - The PPC XXPERMDI instruction.
The CMPB instruction (takes two operands of i32 or i64).
Hi/Lo - These represent the high and low 16-bit parts of a global address respectively.

detaileddescription.para: These nodes have two operands, the first of which must be a TargetGlobalAddress, and the second of which must be a Constant. Selected naively, these turn into 'lis G+C' and 'li G+C', though these are usually folded into other nodes.

briefdescription.para: The following two target-specific nodes are used for calls through function pointers in the 64-bit SVR4 ABI.

detaileddescription.para: OPRC, CHAIN = DYNALLOC(CHAIN, NEGSIZE, FRAME_INDEX) This instruction is lowered in PPCRegisterInfo::eliminateFrameIndex to compute an allocation on the stack.

briefdescription.para: This instruction is lowered in PPCRegisterInfo::eliminateFrameIndex to compute an offset from native SP to the address of the most recent dynamic alloca.
To avoid stack clash, allocation is performed by block and each block is probed.
The result of the mflr at function entry, used for PIC code.
These nodes represent PPC shifts.

detaileddescription.para: For scalar types, only the last n + 1 bits of the shift amounts are used, where n is log2(sizeof(element) * 8). See sld/slw, etc. for exact behaviors.
For vector types, only the last n bits are used. See vsld.

briefdescription.para: FNMSUB - Negated multiply-subtract instruction.
EXTSWSLI = The PPC extswsli instruction, which does an extend-sign word and shift left immediate.
The combination of sra[wd]i and addze used to implemented signed integer division by a power of 2.

detaileddescription.para: The first operand is the dividend, and the second is the constant shift amount (representing the divisor).

briefdescription.para: CALL - A direct function call.

detaileddescription.para: CALL_NOP is a call with the special NOP which follows 64-bit CALL_NOTOC the caller does not use the TOC. SVR4 calls and 32-bit/64-bit AIX calls.

briefdescription.para: CHAIN,FLAG = MTCTR(VAL, CHAIN[, INFLAG]) - Directly corresponds to a MTCTR instruction.
CHAIN,FLAG = BCTRL(CHAIN, INFLAG) - Directly corresponds to a BCTRL instruction.
CHAIN,FLAG = BCTRL(CHAIN, ADDR, INFLAG) - The combination of a bctrl instruction and the TOC reload required on 64-bit ELF, 32-bit AIX and 64-bit AIX.
The variants that implicitly define rounding mode for calls with strictfp semantics.
Return with a glue operand, matched by 'blr'.
R32 = MFOCRF(CRREG, INFLAG) - Represents the MFOCRF instruction.

detaileddescription.para: This copies the bits corresponding to the specified CRREG into the resultant GPR. Bits corresponding to other CR regs are undefined.

briefdescription.para: Direct move from a VSX register to a GPR.
Direct move from a GPR to a VSX register (algebraic)
Direct move from a GPR to a VSX register (zero)
Direct move of 2 consecutive GPR to a VSX register.
BUILD_SPE64 and EXTRACT_SPE are analogous to BUILD_PAIR and EXTRACT_ELEMENT but take f64 arguments instead of i64, as i64 is unsupported for this target.

detaileddescription.para: Merge 2 GPRs to a single SPE register.

briefdescription.para: Extract SPE register component, second argument is high or low.
Extract a subvector from signed integer vector and convert to FP.

detaileddescription.para: It is primarily used to convert a (widened) illegal integer vector type to a legal floating point vector type. For example v2i32 -> widened to v4i32 -> v2f64

briefdescription.para: Extract a subvector from unsigned integer vector and convert to FP.

detaileddescription.para: As with SINT_VEC_TO_FP, used for converting illegal types.

briefdescription.para: PowerPC instructions that have SCALAR_TO_VECTOR semantics tend to place the value into the least significant element of the most significant doubleword in the vector.

detaileddescription.para: This is not element zero for anything smaller than a doubleword on either endianness. This node has the same semantics as SCALAR_TO_VECTOR except that the value remains in the aforementioned location in the vector register.

briefdescription.para: i1 = ANDI_rec_1_[EQ|GT]_BIT(i32 or i64 x) - Represents the result of the eq or gt bit of CR0 after executing andi.

detaileddescription.para: x, 1. This is used to implement truncation of i32 or i64 to i1.

briefdescription.para: RESVEC = VCMP(LHS, RHS, OPC) - Represents one of the altivec VCMP* instructions.

detaileddescription.para: For lack of better number, we use the opcode number encoding for the OPC field to identify the compare. For example, 838 is VCMPGTSH.

briefdescription.para: RESVEC, OUTFLAG = VCMP_rec(LHS, RHS, OPC) - Represents one of the altivec VCMP*_rec instructions.

detaileddescription.para: For lack of better number, we use the opcode number encoding for the OPC field to identify the compare. For example, 838 is VCMPGTSH.

briefdescription.para: CHAIN = COND_BRANCH CHAIN, CRRC, OPC, DESTBB [, INFLAG] - This corresponds to the COND_BRANCH pseudo instruction.

detaileddescription.para: CRRC is the condition register to branch on, OPC is the branch opcode to use (e.g. PPC::BLE), DESTBB is the destination block to branch to, and INFLAG is an optional input flag argument.

briefdescription.para: CHAIN = BDNZ CHAIN, DESTBB - These are used to create counter-based loops.
F8RC = FADDRTZ F8RC, F8RC - This is an FADD done with rounding towards zero.

detaileddescription.para: Used only as part of the long double-to-int conversion sequence.

briefdescription.para: F8RC = MFFS - This moves the FPSCR (not modeled) into the register.
TC_RETURN - A tail call return.

detaileddescription.para: operand #0 chain operand #1 callee (register or absolute) operand #2 stack adjustment operand #3 optional in flag

briefdescription.para: ch, gl = CR6[UN]SET ch, inglue - Toggle CR bit 6 for SVR4 vararg calls
GPRC = address of GLOBAL_OFFSET_TABLE.

detaileddescription.para: Used by initial-exec TLS for non-position independent code on PPC32.

briefdescription.para: GPRC = address of GLOBAL_OFFSET_TABLE.

detaileddescription.para: Used by general dynamic and local dynamic TLS and position indendepent code on PPC32.

briefdescription.para: G8RC = ADDIS_GOT_TPREL_HA x2, Symbol - Used by the initial-exec TLS model, produces an ADDIS8 instruction that adds the GOT base to sym@got@tprel@ha.
G8RC = LD_GOT_TPREL_L Symbol, G8RReg - Used by the initial-exec TLS model, produces a LD instruction with base register G8RReg and offset sym@got@tprel@l.

detaileddescription.para: This completes the addition that finds the offset of "sym" relative to the thread pointer.

briefdescription.para: G8RC = ADD_TLS G8RReg, Symbol - Can be used by the initial-exec and local-exec TLS models, produces an ADD instruction that adds the contents of G8RReg to the thread pointer.

detaileddescription.para: Symbol contains a relocation sym@tls which is to be replaced by the thread pointer and identifies to the linker that the instruction is part of a TLS sequence.

briefdescription.para: G8RC = ADDIS_TLSGD_HA x2, Symbol - For the general-dynamic TLS model, produces an ADDIS8 instruction that adds the GOT base register to sym@got@tlsgd@ha.
x3 = ADDI_TLSGD_L G8RReg, Symbol - For the general-dynamic TLS model, produces an ADDI8 instruction that adds G8RReg to sym@got@tlsgd@l and stores the result in X3.

detaileddescription.para: Hidden by ADDIS_TLSGD_L_ADDR until after register assignment.

briefdescription.para: x3 = GET_TLS_ADDR x3, Symbol - For the general-dynamic TLS model, produces a call to __tls_get_addr(sym@tlsgd).

detaileddescription.para: Hidden by ADDIS_TLSGD_L_ADDR until after register assignment.

briefdescription.para: x3 = GET_TPOINTER - Used for the local- and initial-exec TLS model on 32-bit AIX, produces a call to .__get_tpointer to retrieve the thread pointer.

detaileddescription.para: At the end of the call, the thread pointer is found in R3.

briefdescription.para: G8RC = ADDI_TLSGD_L_ADDR G8RReg, Symbol, Symbol - Op that combines ADDI_TLSGD_L and GET_TLS_ADDR until expansion following register assignment.

GPRC = TLSGD_AIX, TOC_ENTRY, TOC_ENTRY G8RC = TLSGD_AIX, TOC_ENTRY, TOC_ENTRY Op that combines two register copies of TOC entries (region handle into R3 and variable offset into R4) followed by a GET_TLS_ADDR node which will be expanded to a call to .__tls_get_addr.

detaileddescription.para: This node is used in 64-bit mode as well (in which case the result is G8RC and inputs are X3/X4).

briefdescription.para: x3 = GET_TLS_MOD_AIX _$TLSML - For the AIX local-dynamic TLS model, produces a call to .__tls_get_mod(_$TLSML@ml).

[GP|G8]RC = TLSLD_AIX, TOC_ENTRY(module handle) Op that requires a single input of the module handle TOC entry in R3, and generates a GET_TLS_MOD_AIX node which will be expanded into a call to .__tls_get_mod.

detaileddescription.para: This node is used in both 32-bit and 64-bit modes. The only difference is the register class.

briefdescription.para: G8RC = ADDIS_TLSLD_HA x2, Symbol - For the local-dynamic TLS model, produces an ADDIS8 instruction that adds the GOT base register to sym@got@tlsld@ha.
x3 = ADDI_TLSLD_L G8RReg, Symbol - For the local-dynamic TLS model, produces an ADDI8 instruction that adds G8RReg to sym@got@tlsld@l and stores the result in X3.

detaileddescription.para: Hidden by ADDIS_TLSLD_L_ADDR until after register assignment.

briefdescription.para: x3 = GET_TLSLD_ADDR x3, Symbol - For the local-dynamic TLS model, produces a call to __tls_get_addr(sym@tlsld).

detaileddescription.para: Hidden by ADDIS_TLSLD_L_ADDR until after register assignment.

briefdescription.para: G8RC = ADDI_TLSLD_L_ADDR G8RReg, Symbol, Symbol - Op that combines ADDI_TLSLD_L and GET_TLSLD_ADDR until expansion following register assignment.
G8RC = ADDIS_DTPREL_HA x3, Symbol - For the local-dynamic TLS model, produces an ADDIS8 instruction that adds X3 to sym@dtprel@ha.
G8RC = ADDI_DTPREL_L G8RReg, Symbol - For the local-dynamic TLS model, produces an ADDI8 instruction that adds G8RReg to sym@got@dtprel@l.
G8RC = PADDI_DTPREL x3, Symbol - For the pc-rel based local-dynamic TLS model, produces a PADDI8 instruction that adds X3 to sym@dtprel.
VRRC = VADD_SPLAT Elt, EltSize - Temporary node to be expanded during instruction selection to optimize a BUILD_VECTOR into operations on splats.

detaileddescription.para: This is necessary to avoid losing these optimizations due to constant folding.

briefdescription.para: CHAIN = SC CHAIN, Imm128 - System call.

detaileddescription.para: The 7-bit unsigned operand identifies the operating system entry point.

briefdescription.para: CHAIN = CLRBHRB CHAIN - Clear branch history rolling buffer.
GPRC, CHAIN = MFBHRBE CHAIN, Entry, Dummy - Move from branch history rolling buffer entry.
CHAIN = RFEBB CHAIN, State - Return from event-based branch.
VSRC, CHAIN = XXSWAPD CHAIN, VSRC - Occurs only for little endian.

detaileddescription.para: Maps to an xxswapd instruction that corrects an lxvd2x or stxvd2x instruction. The chain is necessary because the sequence replaces a load and needs to provide the same number of outputs.

briefdescription.para: An SDNode for swaps that are not associated with any loads/stores and thereby have no chain.
FP_EXTEND_HALF(VECTOR, IDX) - Custom extend upper (IDX=0) half or lower (IDX=1) half of v4f32 to v2f64.
MAT_PCREL_ADDR = Materialize a PC Relative address.

detaileddescription.para: This can be done either through an add like PADDI or through a PC Relative load like PLD.

briefdescription.para: TLS_DYNAMIC_MAT_PCREL_ADDR = Materialize a PC Relative address for TLS global address when using dynamic access models.

detaileddescription.para: This can be done through an add like PADDI.

briefdescription.para: TLS_LOCAL_EXEC_MAT_ADDR = Materialize an address for TLS global address when using local exec access models, and when prefixed instructions are available.

detaileddescription.para: This is used with ADD_TLS to produce an add like PADDI.

briefdescription.para: ACC_BUILD = Build an accumulator register from 4 VSX registers.
PAIR_BUILD = Build a vector pair register from 2 VSX registers.
EXTRACT_VSX_REG = Extract one of the underlying vsx registers of an accumulator or pair register.

detaileddescription.para: This node is needed because EXTRACT_SUBVECTOR expects the input and output vectors to have the same element type.

briefdescription.para: XXMFACC = This corresponds to the xxmfacc instruction.
Constrained integer-to-floating-point conversion instructions.
Constrained floating point add in round-to-zero mode.
SETBC - The ISA 3.1 (P10) SETBC instruction.
SETBCR - The ISA 3.1 (P10) SETBCR instruction.
CHAIN = STBRX CHAIN, GPRC, Ptr, Type - This is a byte-swapping store instruction.

detaileddescription.para: It byte-swaps the low "Type" bits of the GPRC input, then stores it through Ptr. Type can be either i16 or i32.

briefdescription.para: GPRC, CHAIN = LBRX CHAIN, Ptr, Type - This is a byte-swapping load instruction.

detaileddescription.para: It loads "Type" bits, byte swaps it, then puts it in the bottom bits of the GPRC. TYPE can be either i16 or i32.

briefdescription.para: STFIWX - The STFIWX instruction.

detaileddescription.para: The first operand is an input token chain, then an f64 value to store, then an address to store it to.

briefdescription.para: GPRC, CHAIN = LFIWAX CHAIN, Ptr - This is a floating-point load which sign-extends from a 32-bit integer value into the destination 64-bit register.
GPRC, CHAIN = LFIWZX CHAIN, Ptr - This is a floating-point load which zero-extends from a 32-bit integer value into the destination 64-bit register.
GPRC, CHAIN = LXSIZX, CHAIN, Ptr, ByteWidth - This is a load of an integer smaller than 64 bits into a VSR.

detaileddescription.para: The integer is zero-extended. This can be used for converting loaded integers to floating point.

briefdescription.para: STXSIX - The STXSI[bh]X instruction.

detaileddescription.para: The first operand is an input chain, then an f64 value to store, then an address to store it to, followed by a byte-width for the store.

briefdescription.para: VSRC, CHAIN = LXVD2X_LE CHAIN, Ptr - Occurs only for little endian.

detaileddescription.para: Maps directly to an lxvd2x instruction that will be followed by an xxswapd.

briefdescription.para: LXVRZX - Load VSX Vector Rightmost and Zero Extend This node represents v1i128 BUILD_VECTOR of a zero extending load instruction from <byte, halfword, word, or doubleword> to i128.

detaileddescription.para: Allows utilization of the Load VSX Vector Rightmost Instructions.

briefdescription.para: VSRC, CHAIN = LOAD_VEC_BE CHAIN, Ptr - Occurs only for little endian.

detaileddescription.para: Maps directly to one of lxvd2x/lxvw4x/lxvh8x/lxvb16x depending on the vector type to load vector in big-endian element order.

briefdescription.para: VSRC, CHAIN = LD_VSX_LH CHAIN, Ptr - This is a floating-point load of a v2f32 value into the lower half of a VSR register.
VSRC, CHAIN = LD_SPLAT, CHAIN, Ptr - a splatting load memory instructions such as LXVDSX, LXVWSX.
VSRC, CHAIN = ZEXT_LD_SPLAT, CHAIN, Ptr - a splatting load memory that zero-extends.
VSRC, CHAIN = SEXT_LD_SPLAT, CHAIN, Ptr - a splatting load memory that sign-extends.
CHAIN = STXVD2X CHAIN, VSRC, Ptr - Occurs only for little endian.

detaileddescription.para: Maps directly to an stxvd2x instruction that will be preceded by an xxswapd.

briefdescription.para: CHAIN = STORE_VEC_BE CHAIN, VSRC, Ptr - Occurs only for little endian.

detaileddescription.para: Maps directly to one of stxvd2x/stxvw4x/stxvh8x/stxvb16x depending on the vector type to store vector in big-endian element order.

briefdescription.para: Store scalar integers from VSR.
ATOMIC_CMP_SWAP - the exact same as the target-independent nodes except they ensure that the compare input is zero-extended for sub-word versions because the atomic loads zero-extend.
CHAIN,Glue = STORE_COND CHAIN, GPR, Ptr The store conditional instruction ST[BHWD]ARX that produces a glue result to attach it to a conditional branch.
GPRC = TOC_ENTRY GA, TOC Loads the entry for GA from the TOC, where the TOC base is given by the last operand.
